input.input_filter: semantic_status starts ACCEPT and canonicalization_status=PASS only

objective: Measure full-population Kalshi pre-event market-history availability from T-10d to T-1h for every accepted canonical_event_id before any ForecastEx census, Polymarket recensus, linked-asset outcome read or official-event-truth attachment.

operational_t0.definition: For each canonical_event_id, take the earliest parseable latest_close_time among its accepted Kalshi alias event rows. This is a conservative venue reference only.
operational_t0.reason: Official event truth is intentionally later in the user-fixed W4-B sequence. Earliest alias close avoids selecting a later venue timestamp that could artificially improve measured pre-event coverage.
operational_t0.claim_limit: No W4-B history result may call this official event time or final PIT truth. Official-truth stage must later revalidate timing.

route_resolution: If and only if historical returns HTTP 404, attempt GET /series/{series_ticker}/markets/{ticker}/candlesticks.
A 200 response, including an empty candlestick array, resolves the route.
Non-404 4xx, 5xx after retries, timeout exhaustion, invalid JSON, or 404 on both routes is API_UNRESOLVED and fails the technical materialization gate.
candlestick_contract.kalshi_contract_basis: Official Kalshi documentation: settled markets older than historical cutoff and their candlesticks must use the historical namespace; valid single-market candlestick periods include 60 minutes.

horizon_rule: For a market/horizon, select the latest real 1h candlestick end_period_ts at or before T0-horizon. Valid iff target_ts - candle_ts is between 0 and the preregistered max_staleness. No synthetic latest-before-start candle is requested.

event_aggregation.horizon_any_valid: TRUE iff at least one constituent market ticker is valid at that horizon.
event_aggregation.horizon_market_fraction_valid: valid constituent markets / technically resolved constituent markets.
event_aggregation.CORE_T10_TO_T1H: T-240h and T-1h any-valid and at least 8/10 horizons any-valid
event_aggregation.PARTIAL: at least one but not CORE_T10_TO_T1H
event_aggregation.NO_T10D: T-240h invalid but some later horizon valid
event_aggregation.DISTRIBUTIONAL_CORE_FLAG: descriptive only: >=50% market validity at T-240h and T-1h plus >=8/10 event-level horizons; never increases independent N

canonical_alias_policy: All accepted Kalshi alias rows sharing canonical_event_id are pooled into that one canonical event; all unique constituent market_tickers across aliases are audited. Aliases and strikes never add independent N.

gate.technical_pass: 387/387 canonical events represented, every unique constituent ticker technically resolved through exactly one successful route, zero API_UNRESOLVED, deterministic outputs.
gate.scientific_interpretation: History classes quantify venue-side availability only. They do not establish official event timing, asset mapping, cross-venue uniqueness or N_final_backtestable.
